prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible, move to it and grab, check properties. Then move to destination. If not visible, scan, approach or do specific task. list of available nodes: <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObjectAndCheckProperties    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO MoveToObject
	ELSE
		DO GrabObjectAndCheckProperties
		DO MoveToDestination
	END
